nodes.prompt:
TASK: Independently execute the complete ORCA Lite release acceptance checks after the retained Web batch terminates.
DELIVERABLE: A PASS/FAIL evidence report giving each literal command, exit code, relevant output, production chunk warning status, and git status --short.
SCOPE: Read only /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite and command output. Do not modify files, run Web helpers, create/close/resume Web scopes, commit, or use destructive Git commands.
VERIFY: Run exactly cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml; cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings; bun --cwd ui test; bun --cwd ui run build. PASS means every command exits 0. Inspect the final Vite output for chunk warnings.
STOP WHEN: Return PASS with all four successful command outputs, or return the first concrete failing command with output.
